description: This Java class 'Menu' represents a menu item for web-based UI, including properties such as code, URL, icon, role, order, and nested sub-menus. It is serializable and uses Jackson annotations for JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: Represents a web UI menu item with possible sub-menus and associated properties.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the menu.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL for the menu.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the display order of the menu.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the display order of the menu.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon associated with the menu.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon for the menu.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the role associated with the menu.

methods.name: setRole
methods.description: Sets the role for the menu.
